images.prompt: An orange coastal lighthouse above a stone harbor, with one small white sailboat, a blue door and green shrubs visible in a coherent wide travel photograph. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The source is a coherent coastal photograph with one complete orange lighthouse, one sailboat, a blue door and a curved harbor wall, suitable for extracting distinct scene details.

images.actual_source_analysis: An orange cylindrical lighthouse rises at upper right above stone steps and dense green shrubs with small pink flowers. A vivid blue arched door opens in the stone wall below. A curved harbor wall surrounds foreground water. One small white sailboat sits on the sea at left, with a rocky distant coast and blue sky.
